slots.jd.community-hospital.about:
Summary
Pinebrook Medical Center is a community hospital in Toledo, OH, committed to safe, compassionate care for every neighbor who walks through our doors. We are seeking a Graduate Registered Nurse to join our on-site nursing team and grow under the guidance of experienced staff. Candidates must hold a current Registered Nurse Licence and a Basic Life Support Card.
slots.jd.community-hospital.duties:
Duties
- Assess patients on admission and throughout each shift, and report changes in condition to the charge nurse.
- Coordinate with physicians and the wider care team on treatment plans and new orders.
- Prepare and give medications safely, following hospital policy and physician orders.
- Monitor vital signs and respond promptly to abnormal findings.
- Record assessments, interventions and patient responses accurately in the health record.
- Teach patients and families about their care, medications and discharge instructions.
slots.jd.community-hospital.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- Current Registered Nurse Licence (required).
- Advanced Cardiac Life Support Card (preferred).
- 2 or more years of nursing experience.
- Working skill in patient assessment, vital signs monitoring, care planning and triage.
- Sound clinical documentation habits and knowledge of infection control practices.
slots.r1.b1: Documents care planning updates in the clinic record at each visit, reducing charting errors found in audits by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Gives bedside shift handoff reports that summarize vital signs monitoring trends, so the incoming nurse has current readings for each patient.
slots.r1.b3: Completes a patient assessment before each medication administration, cutting medication timing delays by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Coordinates with physicians on discharge planning, confirming orders, follow-up appointments and home care instructions before patients leave the clinic.
slots.r1.i1: Graduate Registered Nurse at Harborview Community Clinic, charting assessments and care notes in the patient record under the supervision of senior nursing staff.
slots.r1.i2: Provides direct patient care at Harborview Community Clinic with a focus on safe medication administration, guided by experienced registered nurses.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level graduate registered nurse with about 2 years of experience in community clinic care, working alongside a supervising nurse on an assigned share of patients. Skilled in bedside handoff, vital signs monitoring and care planning, with a B.S.N. from Lakeshore University.
slots.summary.2: Graduate registered nurse with about 2 years of hands-on clinical experience, holding a Registered Nurse Licence and a Basic Life Support Card. Handles a small patient assignment under close supervision, contributing bedside handoff, vital signs monitoring and care planning.
